prompt:

Maintain a stable ground anchor, fixed perspective, identical proportions, consistent pixel details and a smooth loop.

The character walks IN PLACE.

No turning toward the camera, no frontal face, no side profile, no running, no attacks, no sword swings, no teleporting, no extra limbs, no morphing armor, no changing weapon size, no floating feet, no foot sliding, no background and no camera movement.
